question: Which point-index, normalization, cache or labelled-collision changes lower useful native relation cost and then cold verified one-target ECDLP cost?
decision_value: Separate point decoding/preparation reuse from membership proof reuse and table lookup itself. Retain an implementation only where its complete setup-plus-query cost justifies its memory and verification costs; confirm one selected implementation on fresh public targets. A warm-only gain, ineffective cache or coordinator bottleneck changes the next implementation choice without becoming a whole-pipeline speed claim.

resources.notes: Proposed pilot ceiling only, unapproved and uncalibrated. One native L2 Spot job, concurrency 1, original 1800s absolute deadline. At most 2 reserved vCPU-hours for payload under this ceiling; builders/queue/idle/storage/transfer are additional and must be priced before readiness. Multi-host work needs a separate matched-host protocol within existing authorized caps.
